data.one_liner: A Dart package to handle dynamic String and Json interpolation.
data.what_it_does: It provides methods to evaluate and interpolate dynamic strings using variable maps and nested object paths. It also allows traversing and fully resolving JSON-like objects containing interpolation templates.
use_when: You need to dynamically interpolate strings with map data at runtime.
You need to resolve nested string templates inside JSON or Map structures.
avoid_when: You only need standard Dart compile-time string interpolation.
You require complex logic evaluation within string templates.
strengths: Supports nested object path resolution using dot notation.
Can traverse and resolve entire JSON structures safely without altering the original object.
weaknesses: Limited to basic map lookups for interpolation keys.
No documentation on complex expression evaluation.
